provider.organization_type: global prokaryotic nomenclature, taxonomy, name-status, type-strain, bibliography, validation-list, API, download, and data-integration infrastructure
provider.description: The List of Prokaryotic names with Standing in Nomenclature provides authoritative nomenclatural information for Bacteria and Archaea. It records scientific names, ranks, authorship, valid publication, standing in nomenclature, legitimacy, synonyms, basonyms, nomenclatural types, type strains, culture-collection accessions, etymology, publications, validation lists, judicial opinions, Candidatus names, classifications, persistent identifiers, APIs, downloads, and version history.
institutional_context: International Committee on Systematics of Prokaryotes
International Journal of Systematic and Evolutionary Microbiology
Global prokaryotic systematics, culture-collection, genomic, and nomenclatural communities

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting LPSN documentation, prokaryotic names, nomenclatural status, taxonomic hierarchy, type material, type strains, culture-collection accessions, etymology, publications, validation lists, judicial opinions, Candidatus names, APIs, accounts, downloads, schemas, licenses, citations, related standards, institutions, and authorities.
purpose.authoritative_notice: LPSN, DSMZ, ICSP, the International Code of Nomenclature of Prokaryotes, IJSEM, official validation lists, judicial opinions, cited publications, culture collections, and official API or download releases remain authoritative for names, status, types, strains, versions, licenses, citations, and contacts.

Preserve LPSN identifier, scientific name, nomenclatural status, reference, release version, access date, license URI, rights holder, and citation.
Do not assume public web access grants unrestricted bulk redistribution or reuse of linked publication content.
Seed URLs are best-effort and were not live-verified in this session.
The acquisition program should update retrieval, content, review, and verification fields in place.
LPSN website routes, API host and endpoints, account requirements, download filenames, validation-list pages, and schema details may change; preserve redirect and failure metadata.
Do not recursively crawl every genus, species, strain, reference, validation-list entry, or API result when the task is documentation acquisition.
